mechanism: Embedding a thin layer of electrospun nanofibers with antimicrobial peptides into the Dacron graft surface
how_it_addresses_failure: The embedded nanofibers provide a physical barrier against bacterial colonization, reducing the likelihood of infection and explantation.
falsifier: If the nanofibers do not significantly reduce bacterial colonization rates compared to the current device.

mechanism: Integrating a biosensor that detects the presence of Gram-negative bacteria and releases a localized, targeted dose of antimicrobial agents
how_it_addresses_failure: The biosensor detects the presence of target bacteria and releases a targeted dose of antimicrobial agents, reducing the risk of bacterial resistance and improving efficacy.
falsifier: If the biosensor fails to detect bacterial presence or releases the antimicrobial agents at an inappropriate time.

mechanism: Developing a temperature-sensitive Dacron graft that changes its surface properties in response to body temperature, reducing bacterial adhesion
how_it_addresses_failure: The temperature-sensitive graft changes its surface properties in response to body temperature, reducing bacterial adhesion and colonization.
falsifier: If the graft does not change its surface properties in response to body temperature or fails to reduce bacterial adhesion.

mechanism: Coating the Dacron graft with a layer of heparin, which inhibits bacterial adhesion and promotes the growth of beneficial bacteria
how_it_addresses_failure: The heparin coating inhibits bacterial adhesion and promotes the growth of beneficial bacteria, reducing the risk of infection and explantation.
falsifier: If the heparin coating does not inhibit bacterial adhesion or promote the growth of beneficial bacteria.

mechanism: Embedding micro-scale piezoelectric devices into the Dacron graft that generate a localized electric field, disrupting bacterial cell membranes and DNA replication
how_it_addresses_failure: The piezoelectric devices generate a localized electric field that disrupts bacterial cell membranes and DNA replication, reducing the risk of infection and explantation.
falsifier: If the piezoelectric devices do not generate a localized electric field or fail to disrupt bacterial cell membranes and DNA replication.
